title: Snow & Shadows: Chasing Tails x Lucy
description: Mashup bringing Chasing Tails -A Promise in the Snow- and Lucy Got Problems into Minecraft! Explore Snow Town and the Elven Forest, interact with June, Rin, Lucy, Ellie, and Thea in fully rendered 2D, and collect custom items.
tagline: Explore two new dimensions and meet 5 VN characters with original art and music.
